reference: No GNU canvas CLI exists. Fixed independent RGBA/P6 byte arrays follow documented row order, opaque alpha, clipping, resize and scroll rules; Bash metadata remains separate. Every image operation uses a tiny headless canvas and relative private files.
coverage: Headless operation contracts: clear/pixel/rect clipping, independent P6 and RGBA imports/exports, clipped blit, viewport scroll, overlap-preserving resize/black fill, ownership, repeated stop, restart, import errors and save failure recovery.
Terminal presentation/input and native GLES/DMA-BUF operations are deferred with dedicated prerequisites.
exclusions: Antialiased line/circle/polyline edges and bitmap font glyphs are not exhaustively checked; no general raster equivalence is claimed.
Shell-exit/module-unload resource release needs a reviewed lifecycle observer; explicit stop/restart is covered.
No terminal, render node, GPU driver, native shader or DMA-BUF operation is invoked.

cases.purpose: Verify Bash's type builtin classifies the available gpu loadable as a builtin.
Check that no-argument, --help, and help invocations expose the same documented gpu synopsis, including canvas, presentation, and shader commands.
cases.script:
plain=$(gpu)
long=$(gpu --help)
alias=$(gpu help)
[[ $plain == "$long" && $long == "$alias" ]]
[[ $plain == *'gpu start WIDTH HEIGHT'* ]]
[[ $plain == *'present [X Y WIDTH HEIGHT]'* ]]
[[ $plain == *'gpu shader FRAGMENT_FILE'* ]]
printf 'gpu help entry points and synopsis are available\n'
cases.stdout: gpu help entry points and synopsis are available

cases.purpose: Verify the loadable's Bash help metadata is registered and advertises representative documented drawing and image commands.
cases.script:
metadata=$(help gpu)
[[ $metadata == *'gpu COMMAND [ARGUMENT ...]'* ]]
[[ $metadata == *'gpu rect X Y W H RRGGBB'* ]]
[[ $metadata == *'gpu load PPM_FILE'* ]]
printf 'gpu Bash help metadata is registered\n'
cases.stdout: gpu Bash help metadata is registered

cases.purpose: Validate full frames, damage patches, scroll composition, synchronization, terminal rejection/fallback, and shared-memory cleanup for inline and shared-memory transports.
cases.reason: A future disposable VM needs a bounded PTY terminal peer implementing the Kitty graphics protocol and private shared-memory acknowledgements. The current declarative runner supplies no PTY peer, and no real terminal is within scope.

cases.purpose: Validate key, UTF-8, mouse, resize, and timeout event decoding plus restoration of terminal settings on return and failure.
cases.reason: A future disposable VM needs a PTY driver that sends deterministic event sequences and independently checks variable bindings, timeouts, and termios restoration. The current runner has no controllable terminal fixture.

cases.purpose: Validate shader compile/render output, CPU-canvas shader input retention, resize/readback behavior, and DMA-BUF handoff/fallback and resource retirement.
cases.reason: A future disposable VM must provide an independently reviewed GLES/GBM ABI mock or dedicated render-node fixture with an independent frame oracle and FD handoff peer. This suite does not open render devices or claim GPU rendering passed.

cases.purpose: Fixed 2x2 RGBA oracle checks clear, one pixel, clipping, color prefixes and opaque output.
cases.script:
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu clear 000000
gpu pixel 1 0 "#ff0000"
gpu pixel -1 1 ffffff
gpu pixel 0 1 0x00ff00
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: A rectangle crossing the left boundary covers exactly the left column of the 2x2 image.
cases.script:
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu clear 000000
gpu rect -1 0 2 2 0000ff
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: Independently encoded P6 input loads exact RGB rows and exports the documented opaque P6 format.
Independent RGBA input ignores alpha and retains RGB order and exact output length.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\377\000\000\000\000\377\000\001\000\000\377\200\377\377\377\376' > source.rgba
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu load-rgba source.rgba
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: Blit an independently encoded 2x1 image at a negative X offset; only its second pixel lands on the canvas.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\120\066\012\062\040\061\012\062\065\065\012\377\000\000\000\377\000' > source.ppm
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu clear 000000
gpu blit source.ppm -1 1
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: Scroll a private 1x2 viewport down by one cell, preserve pixels outside it and fill the exposed cell.
cases.script:
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu clear 000000
gpu pixel 0 0 ff0000
gpu pixel 1 0 00ff00
gpu pixel 0 1 0000ff
gpu scroll 0 1 ffffff 0 0 1 2
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: Resize preserves overlap, fills new cells black, rejects a second start and subshell mutation, then permits repeated stop and a fresh session.
cases.script:
gpu start 1 1 --headless
gpu clear ff0000
gpu resize 2 2
gpu save result rgba
rc=0; gpu start 1 1 --headless || rc=$?; [[ $rc == 1 ]]
rc=0; (gpu clear 000000) || rc=$?; [[ $rc == 1 ]]
gpu save after rgba
/usr/bin/cmp result after
gpu info
gpu stop
gpu stop
gpu start 1 1 --headless
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result

cases.purpose: Wrong-size RGBA, mismatched PPM dimensions and a missing save parent fail while preserving a small canvas; later export still succeeds.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\120\066\012\061\040\061\012\062\065\065\012\377\000\000' > small.ppm
printf AB > short.rgba
gpu start 2 2 --headless
gpu clear 000000
for cmd in 'load small.ppm' 'load-rgba short.rgba' 'save absent/output'; do
 read -r -a args <<< "$cmd"
 rc=0; gpu "${args[@]}" || rc=$?; [[ $rc == 1 ]]
done
gpu save result rgba
gpu stop
/usr/bin/cat result
